description:
## 1.36.0-dev.81 (2026-08-09)

- Reddit: make M use the holdable in-app web modal instead of launching native post activities, so release can close reliably.
- Reddit: make G a pure Reddit web embed again with no Morphe CSS/text-zoom/read-more script injection.
- Reddit: improve P/T text-body updates by polling Reddit's in-app model cache and storing cached bodies by post URL.
- Reddit: fix the dev80 build errors before publishing.
